title: Source register
description: Every source the workflow may read. The gateway decides against this; an unregistered source is denied.

review_window_days.description: How long an owner confirmation stays valid before it becomes a finding.

source_id.description: Stable. Never reuse an id for a different source.

owner_holder.description: The person doing that job today. 'UNCONFIRMED' is valid and is reported as a finding — it is never silently blank.

owner_confirmed.description: When THEY confirmed it, not when you wrote it down.

data_class.description: What is IN the file, not where it is stored. Unknown values fail closed at the gateway.

export_proven.description: True only if a real export was actually pulled. Assuming this is how engagements die late.

manual_step_required.description: If a person must do something every cycle, that is a dependency with a name attached, not an integration.
